reviews.title: Works well with gaming computer
reviews.comment: The Intel Core i7-12700KF is an outstanding processor for gaming, streaming, and productivity. With 12 cores and boost speeds up to 5.0 GHz, it handles demanding games and multitasking with ease while staying competitive with newer CPUs. It’s unlocked for overclocking, works with both DDR4 and DDR5 platforms, and offers excellent value for high-performance PC builds. The only downside is that it runs best with a strong cooler since it can get fairly warm under heavy workloads.
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.title: This processor proves that you don't need the latest technology if you're on a tight budget.
reviews.comment: I generally don't leave a review when I buy a product because doing so prematurely wouldn't be objective. I've had this processor running for 18 months, working 12 to 16 hours a day. I do video editing, up to 4K quality, using programs like Adobe Premiere and DaVinci Resolve, as well as artificial intelligence, After Effects, and photo retouching. I haven't had any problems. I have it with liquid cooling, and the case has good ventilation. Before this processor, I had a Ryzen processor and experienced workflow issues, so I decided to switch to Intel. After researching industry professionals who recommended it, I decided this was the best option, and I don't regret it. I haven't had any problems; it's fast and, to this day, reliable.
